title: Wonder Works Children's Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Wonder Works reserves Tuesdays and Wednesdays to welcome schools and daycare groups for field trips. Your group will have private access for two hours to the museum’s eight permanent exhibits. The museum’s exhibits are specially designed to promote STEM concepts, collaborative play, gross and fine motors skills and math concepts. Your school or daycare group will have a great time learning through creative play at Wonder Works! Small groups are welcome to come to Wonder Works at any time without a reservation but admission may not be possible if we are operating at high capacity. Wonder Works offers free admission to our members and CLIMB members from our CLIMB Network museums until the program expires on June 30, 2026. To become a member of Wonder Works, see our membership page. Please note that CLIMB memberships are no longer available at any Chicago area children’s museum. 50% off cost of Wonder Works admission per guest (up to 6 guests) for participating museums.
